sourceHtml:
Amazon Polly Generative engine now offers more natural and accurate speech output. We’re introducing an upgrade to the Amazon Polly Generative engine that delivers more expressive, more accurate speech output with low latency. The upgrade adds 14 new voices across 9 locales, including general availability of Generative voices in Hindi and Finnish for the first time. The upgrade is now generally available in production.

Importantly, this is a drop-in upgrade for existing generative voices. Voice names and API calls are unchanged, so your existing applications continue to work as they do today.

Amazon Polly is a fully managed AWS service that converts text into natural-sounding speech for contact centers, large language model (LLM)-based agentic applications, media and entertainment, e-learning, accessibility, and other applications that require reliable voice output at scale.

Hear the difference

You can use sample audio to evaluate the improvements directly.

  • The more natural, authentic, and expressive voices. Hear how Tiffany welcomes you in a delightful tone.
    • “Hi there! I’m Tiffany, one of Polly’s generative voices. I was built to sound natural, expressive, and a little bit delightful. What should we talk about?”
  • Accurate speech generation for numbers, currency, addresses, and so on. Kenneth reads back an order confirmation, including the tracking number, date and time, currency and address accurately.
    • “Thanks for calling. Your order, number 4471 9902 ships today to 85 Harbor View Drive, Apartment 4B, Portland, Oregon 97209. It should arrive on Thursday, October 22nd, between 9 AM and 1 PM. Your total was $1,284.50 and your confirmation code is K-7-Q-2-X-9.”
  • Net new languages. Arjun and Kiara for Hindi, and Suvi for Finnish. Hindi and Finnish are generally available for the first time on the Amazon Polly Generative engine.
    • Arjun: नमस्कार, आप सुन रहे हैं आज की मुख्य ख़बरें। देश के कई हिस्सों में मानसून की विदाई के साथ मौसम सुहाना हो गया है। (Hello, you’re listening to today’s top stories. As the monsoon retreats across much of the country, the weather has turned pleasant.)
    • Kiara: नमस्ते! मेरा नाम कियारा है। आइए, आज मैं आपको एक छोटी सी कहानी सुनाती हूँ।(Hello! My name is Kiara. Come, let me tell you a little story today.)
    • Suvi: Majakanvartija ei ollut nähnyt laivaa yhteentoista päivään. Sitten, vähän puolenyön jälkeen, horisontissa välähti yksi ainoa valo. Kerran. Kahdesti. Ja sitten, uskomatonta kyllä, se vilkutti takaisin hänen nimensä. (The lighthouse keeper hadn’t seen a ship in eleven days. Then, just after midnight, a single light blinked on the horizon. Once. Twice. And then, impossibly, it blinked back his name.)
  • Different styles of speech delivery based on textual context. Powered by the new Amazon Polly Generative engine, the voices can reflect emotion and prosody even better based on the text input, without manual setup.
    • Neutral: “Your package arrived early.”
    • Uncertainty: “So, um… your package arrived early. I think?”
    • Surprised: “Wait, what? Your package arrived early?”

New voices, languages, and Region availability

  • A larger catalog overall for Amazon Polly Generative engine – Totaling 57 generative voices across 11 languages and 25 locales.
  • 14 new voices across 9 locales – US English (Kenneth, Nate), Australian English (Russell, Curtis), Indian English (Kiara, Arjun), German (Tina), US Spanish (Carlos), Brazilian Portuguese (Leo, Carolina), Korean (Hyunduk), Hindi (Kiara, Arjun) and Finnish (Suvi).
  • Net new languages generally available in Generative engine – Hindi and Finnish.
  • Region expansion to AWS GovCloud (US-West) – Totaling 11 AWS Regions.

Built for production-ready speech workflows for enterprise

The upgraded Amazon Polly Generative engine uses a standard Amazon Polly API call to build your speech applications. With Amazon Polly, you can continue to build with familiar AWS patterns: call the same Amazon Polly API, manage access with AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM), use the output in your existing applications and contact-center flows, and monitor the workloads that synthesize speech for your customers.

This launch is designed to elevate the speech output quality that you can hear with your existing Amazon Polly implementation. No changes to your code are required to get the upgraded voices. For applications that already use Amazon Polly Generative voices, the upgrade happens in place. For new applications, the same SynthesizeSpeech API gives you access to a larger set of generative voice catalogs. With the Bi-Di Streaming API StartSpeechSynthesisStream, you can stream text to Amazon Polly and receive synthesized audio back simultaneously. This is well-suited for real-time applications like voice agents and bespoke characters in games.

Competitive price-performance

The Amazon Polly Generative engine offers competitive pricing on a pay-as-you-go basis. With this model upgrade, you get improved voice quality and accuracy at the same price. There’s no cost increase, no new SKU, and no changes to your existing integration. You can cache and replay synthesized static prompts with no additional cost. Refer to Amazon Polly pricing for complete cost information.

The Amazon Polly Generative engine now delivers more natural, expressive speech alongside low-latency streaming for real-time applications, Speech Synthesis Markup Language (SSML) support for fine-grained control, and the operational reliability of a fully managed AWS service. This combination of quality, performance, and cost efficiency supports a wide range of production use cases.

What you can build

Contact centers. Accuracy matters most in customer service conversations. When a caller checks an order, a voice that reads back the tracking number, address, and confirmation code correctly helps resolve the call in self-service rather than escalating to a human agent. Amazon Polly Generative voice’s accurate entity pronunciation and low-latency generation make automated interactive voice response (IVR) interactions sound more conversational.

Cascaded voice agents. Using Amazon Polly in a voice agent framework, you can convert LLM response text into clear, natural-sounding speech and stream it back to users in near real time over WebSockets or telephony channels. This makes live conversational voice possible. The primary benefits are low-latency playback, high scalability, and cost efficiency.

Media, localization, and dubbing. Convert scripts into finished audio for video, advertising, podcasts, product overviews, and audiobooks. You can use one voice or many, without a studio session. More natural intonation reduces post-production. The expanded locale coverage, including first-time generative Hindi and Finnish, means you can localize a single piece of content into more markets from the same pipeline.

E-learning and training. Narrate courseware, onboarding, and knowledge-based articles at scale, and update them as soon as the source text changes. No re-recording is required. More expressive delivery supports engagement through long-form material.

Accessibility. Provide a clear, natural spoken version of articles, documents, and applications so more people can consume your content by listening: read aloud, on the go, or with a screen reader.

Interactive and transactional experiences. Voice-enable games, kiosks, IVR menus, and IoT devices with responses generated on demand. Use Amazon Polly when the voice needs to sound natural and read names, numbers, product details, addresses, and confirmations reliably.

“At Sanoma Media Finland, we use Amazon Polly to turn our real-time news articles into audio, giving the listener the choice to listen whenever it suits them better. Today we publish over 10,000 articles per month using Polly’s Finnish neural voice. Based on our testing, Suvi’s new generative voice is a clear improvement over the previous neural voice – it sounds noticeably more natural and makes for a more enjoyable experience for the listener.”

— Justus Reinikainen, Product Manager, Sanoma Media Finland

Getting started

You can access the new voices using the AWS Management Console, AWS Command Line Interface (AWS CLI), or the AWS SDKs.

Prerequisites:

  • Active AWS account with Amazon Polly access.
  • AWS Command Line Interface (AWS CLI) installed and configured.
  • Python 3.10+.
  • Boto3 installed: pip install boto3.
  • AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) permissions: polly:SynthesizeSpeech.

Here’s a quick example using the AWS SDK for Python (Boto3) with the SynthesizeSpeech API and a generative voice:

import boto3

polly = boto3.client("polly", region_name="us-east-1")

response = polly.synthesize_speech(
    Text="Hello! This is Amazon Polly's next-generation generative voice.",
    VoiceId="Kenneth",  # any generative voice in the catalogue
    Engine="generative",
    OutputFormat="mp3",
)

with open("speech.mp3", "wb") as f:
    f.write(response["AudioStream"].read())

You can also make the same request with the AWS CLI:

aws polly synthesize-speech \
  --region us-east-1 \
  --voice-id Kenneth \
  --engine generative \
  --output-format mp3 \
  --text "Hello! This is Amazon Polly's next-generation generative voice." \
  speech.mp3

To retrieve the full, current voice list programmatically, call DescribeVoices. You can use this in deployment checks to confirm that a selected generative voice is available in the Region where your application runs.

Availability

The next-generation Generative engine and the new voices are now generally available. The 14 new Generative voices are available in the following AWS Regions: US East (N. Virginia), US West (Oregon), Europe (Frankfurt), Europe (Zurich), Europe (London), Asia Pacific (Sydney), Asia Pacific (Seoul), Asia Pacific (Singapore), Asia Pacific (Tokyo), Canada (Central), and AWS GovCloud (US-West). Getting started, by audience:

  • Developers – Call synthesize_speech with Engine="generative" in your existing application. No other changes are required.
  • Contact-center teams – The improvements reach Amazon Connect and Genesys flows automatically.
  • Everyone – Access any voice in the Amazon Polly console.

A few things to know:

  • Standard and neural voices are unaffected.
  • Speech marks are not available on generative voices (unchanged from today). If your application requires them, standard and neural voices continue to support them.
  • Generative engine continues to support SSML tags. See supported SSML tags for more details.
  • Use current voice availability at runtime. Call DescribeVoices or check the console when deploying across Regions.

Conclusion

The next-generation Generative engine of Amazon Polly is available today, delivering more natural and more accurate voices, adding 14 new voices, including generative voices generally available in Hindi and Finnish for the first time, and requires no change to your code. See Amazon Polly pricing page for pricing information. To get started, open the Amazon Polly console to try the voices, and see the Amazon Polly documentation to build with them.

About the authors

translation.html:
Amazon Polly 生成式引擎现可提供更自然、更准确的语音输出。我们正在推出 Amazon Polly 生成式引擎的升级，以低延迟提供更具表现力、更准确的语音输出。此次升级新增了覆盖 9 个语言区域的 14 种音色，其中印地语和芬兰语生成式音色首次正式可用。此次升级现已正式面向生产环境推出。

重要的是，对于现有生成式音色，此次升级可直接生效。音色名称和 API 调用保持不变，因此现有应用程序会继续照常运行。

Amazon Polly 是一项完全托管的 AWS 服务，可将文本转换为自然的语音，适用于联络中心、基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体应用、媒体与娱乐、在线学习、无障碍功能，以及其他需要大规模可靠语音输出的应用。

听听有什么不同

您可以通过音频示例直接评估这些改进。

  • The more natural, authentic, and expressive voices. Hear how Tiffany welcomes you in a delightful tone.
    • “你好！我是 Tiffany，Polly 的生成式音色之一。我的声音被设计得自然、富有表现力，还带着一点令人愉悦的感觉。我们聊点什么呢？”
  • Accurate speech generation for numbers, currency, addresses, and so on. Kenneth reads back an order confirmation, including the tracking number, date and time, currency and address accurately.
    • “感谢您的来电。您的订单号为 4471 9902，将于今天发货，寄往俄勒冈州波特兰市 Harbor View Drive 85 号 4B 公寓，邮编 97209。预计于 10 月 22 日星期四上午 9 点至下午 1 点之间送达。您的订单总额为 1,284.50 美元，确认码为 K-7-Q-2-X-9。”
  • Net new languages. Arjun and Kiara for Hindi, and Suvi for Finnish. Hindi and Finnish are generally available for the first time on the Amazon Polly Generative engine.
    • Arjun：您好，您正在收听今日头条新闻。随着季风逐渐从全国多地退去，天气变得宜人。（您好，您正在收听今日头条新闻。随着季风逐渐从全国大部分地区退去，天气变得宜人。）
    • Kiara：你好！我叫 Kiara。来吧，今天让我给你讲一个小故事。（你好！我叫 Kiara。来吧，今天让我给你讲一个小故事。）
    • Suvi：灯塔看守人已经十一天没见过船了。随后，刚过午夜，地平线上闪起了一点孤光。一下。两下。接着，令人难以置信的是，它竟以闪光回应，拼出了他的名字。（灯塔看守人已经十一天没见过船了。随后，刚过午夜，地平线上闪起了一点孤光。一下。两下。接着，令人难以置信的是，它竟以闪光回应，拼出了他的名字。）
  • Different styles of speech delivery based on textual context. Powered by the new Amazon Polly Generative engine, the voices can reflect emotion and prosody even better based on the text input, without manual setup.
    • 中性：“你的包裹提前到了。”
    • 不确定：“那个，嗯……你的包裹提前到了。我想是吧？”
    • 惊讶：“等等，什么？你的包裹提前到了？”

新增音色、语言及区域可用性

  • Amazon Polly 生成式引擎的整体音色库进一步扩大——共计 57 种生成式音色，覆盖 11 种语言和 25 个语言区域。
  • 新增 14 种音色，覆盖 9 个语言区域——美式英语（Kenneth、Nate）、澳大利亚英语（Russell、Curtis）、印度英语（Kiara、Arjun）、德语（Tina）、美国西班牙语（Carlos）、巴西葡萄牙语（Leo、Carolina）、韩语（Hyunduk）、印地语（Kiara、Arjun）和芬兰语（Suvi）。
  • 生成式引擎中全新正式可用的语言—— 印地语和芬兰语。
  • 区域覆盖范围扩展至 AWS GovCloud（美国西部）——共计覆盖 11 个 AWS 区域。

专为企业生产级语音工作流打造

升级后的 Amazon Polly 生成式引擎使用标准 Amazon Polly API 调用来构建语音应用程序。借助 Amazon Polly，您可以继续采用熟悉的 AWS 方式进行构建：调用相同的 Amazon Polly API，使用 AWS Identity and Access Management（IAM）管理访问权限，在现有应用程序和联络中心流程中使用输出，并监控为客户合成语音的工作负载。

此次发布旨在提升现有 Amazon Polly 实现中可听到的语音输出质量。无需更改代码，即可获得升级后的音色。对于已经使用 Amazon Polly 生成式音色的应用程序，升级会就地生效。对于新应用程序，同一个 SynthesizeSpeech API 可让您访问更丰富的生成式音色库。借助双向流式 API StartSpeechSynthesisStream，您可以向 Amazon Polly 流式传输文本，同时接收合成音频。这非常适合语音智能体和游戏定制角色等实时应用。

具有竞争力的性价比

Amazon Polly 生成式引擎按实际使用量计费，价格具有竞争力。通过此次模型升级，您可以以相同的价格获得更好的音质和准确性。费用不会增加，没有新增 SKU，也无需更改现有集成。您可以缓存并重播合成的静态提示语，无需额外付费。有关完整费用信息，请参阅 Amazon Polly 定价。

Amazon Polly 生成式引擎现可提供更自然、更具表现力的语音，同时具备面向实时应用的低延迟流式传输、用于精细控制的语音合成标记语言（SSML）支持，以及完全托管的 AWS 服务所具备的运行可靠性。质量、性能与成本效益的结合，可支持广泛的生产用例。

您可以构建哪些应用

联络中心。在客户服务对话中，准确性至关重要。当来电者查询订单时，能够正确读出物流单号、地址和确认码的语音，有助于通过自助服务解决来电问题，避免升级转接至人工客服。Amazon Polly 生成式音色准确的实体发音和低延迟生成能力，让自动交互式语音应答（IVR）交互听起来更像自然对话。

级联式语音智能体。在语音智能体框架中使用 Amazon Polly，可以将 LLM 的回复文本转换为清晰、自然的语音，并通过 WebSocket 或电话通道近乎实时地流式传回给用户。这使实时语音对话成为可能。主要优势包括低延迟播放、高可扩展性和成本效益。

媒体、本地化与配音。将脚本转换为可直接用于视频、广告、播客、产品概览和有声读物的成品音频。您可以使用一种或多种音色，无需进入录音棚录制。更自然的语调可减少后期制作工作。扩大的语言区域覆盖范围，包括首次推出的印地语和芬兰语生成式音色，意味着您可以通过同一条处理流程，将一份内容本地化到更多市场。

在线学习与培训。大规模为课件、入职培训和知识类文章配音，并在源文本发生变化后立即更新。无需重新录音。更具表现力的语音有助于提高受众对长篇内容的参与度。

无障碍功能。为文章、文档和应用程序提供清晰、自然的语音版本，让更多人能够通过收听获取内容：无论是使用朗读功能、在出行途中，还是通过屏幕阅读器。

交互与交易体验。通过按需生成的回复，为游戏、自助终端、IVR 菜单和物联网设备添加语音功能。当您需要语音听起来自然，并能可靠地读出姓名、数字、产品详情、地址和确认信息时，可以使用 Amazon Polly。

“在 Sanoma Media Finland，我们使用 Amazon Polly 将实时新闻文章转换为音频，让听众可以选择在更方便的时候收听。目前，我们每月使用 Polly 的芬兰语神经音色发布超过 10,000 篇文章。根据我们的测试，Suvi 的新生成式音色相较之前的神经音色有明显提升——听起来明显更自然，也为听众带来了更愉悦的体验。”

——Justus Reinikainen，Sanoma Media Finland 产品经理

开始使用

您可以通过 AWS 管理控制台、AWS 命令行界面（AWS CLI）或 AWS SDK 访问这些新音色。

前提条件：

  • 拥有可访问 Amazon Polly 的有效 AWS 账户。
  • 已安装并配置 AWS 命令行界面（AWS CLI）。
  • Python 3.10 及以上版本。
  • 已安装 Boto3：pip install boto3。
  • AWS Identity and Access Management（IAM）权限：polly:SynthesizeSpeech。

下面是一个使用 AWS SDK for Python（Boto3）、SynthesizeSpeech API 和生成式音色的简单示例：

import boto3

polly = boto3.client("polly", region_name="us-east-1")

response = polly.synthesize_speech(
    Text="Hello! This is Amazon Polly's next-generation generative voice.",
    VoiceId="Kenneth",  # any generative voice in the catalogue
    Engine="generative",
    OutputFormat="mp3",
)

with open("speech.mp3", "wb") as f:
    f.write(response["AudioStream"].read())

您也可以通过 AWS CLI 发出相同的请求：

aws polly synthesize-speech \
  --region us-east-1 \
  --voice-id Kenneth \
  --engine generative \
  --output-format mp3 \
  --text "Hello! This is Amazon Polly's next-generation generative voice." \
  speech.mp3

要通过程序获取当前完整的音色列表，请调用 DescribeVoices。您可以在部署检查中使用它，确认所选生成式音色在应用程序运行的区域中可用。

可用性

新一代生成式引擎及新增音色现已正式可用。14 种新增生成式音色可在以下 AWS 区域使用：美国东部（弗吉尼亚北部）、美国西部（俄勒冈）、欧洲（法兰克福）、欧洲（苏黎世）、欧洲（伦敦）、亚太地区（悉尼）、亚太地区（首尔）、亚太地区（新加坡）、亚太地区（东京）、加拿大（中部）以及 AWS GovCloud（美国西部）。不同用户的入门方式如下：

  • 开发者——在现有应用程序中使用 Engine="generative" 调用 synthesize_speech。无需进行其他更改。
  • 联络中心团队——这些改进会自动应用于 Amazon Connect 和 Genesys 流程。
  • 所有用户——在 Amazon Polly 控制台中访问任意音色。

需要了解的几点：

  • 标准音色和神经音色不受影响。
  • 生成式音色不支持语音标记（与目前相同）。如果您的应用程序需要语音标记，标准音色和神经音色仍然支持。
  • 生成式引擎继续支持 SSML 标签。有关更多详情，请参阅支持的 SSML 标签。
  • 在运行时使用当前的音色可用性信息。跨区域部署时，请调用 DescribeVoices 或查看控制台。

结语

Amazon Polly 的新一代生成式引擎现已可用，可提供更自然、更准确的音色，并新增了 14 种音色，其中包括首次正式可用的印地语和芬兰语生成式音色，而且无需更改代码。有关定价信息，请参阅 Amazon Polly 定价页面。要开始使用，请打开 Amazon Polly 控制台试用这些音色，并参阅 Amazon Polly 文档，了解如何使用它们进行构建。

关于作者
